0cd6414f4a.q: How did Chad transition from working in the oil field to becoming a full-time Amazon FBA seller?
0cd6414f4a.a: Chad was laid off from an oil field water measurement company in 2020 when COVID-19 hit and oil prices crashed. He had been saving aggressively and possessed prior reselling knowledge from his grandfather's furniture flipping business. He initially flipped PS5s for cash while learning Amazon FBA through online communities, eventually transitioning full-time as that opportunity dried up. He committed fully to online arbitrage because he loved the data-driven nature of finding and playing sales cycles.

82e2ef8347.q: Why did Chad avoid wholesale sourcing despite five years in Amazon selling?

880667a0dd.q: Why did Chad start selling used electronics on Amazon, and what initial success surprised him?
880667a0dd.a: Chad discovered the used electronics opportunity almost by accident when he found Nikon binoculars at Walmart for $50 that he initially couldn't list as new. After placing it on a shelf for three or four months, he decided to list it used and discovered the used offer was $180—only $20 under the new price—and it sold in a day. This experience made him realize he was sleeping on used inventory, and he has since built scrapers and feeds to identify refurbished and used deals, such as drawing tablets, where the margins make sense to sell as used.
